# Camco Chemical Announces 130,000-Square-Foot Northern Kentucky Distribution Expansion

 Published on Wednesday, September 2, 2026 by Nicole Shakir, Managing Editor of Expansion Solutions Magazine 

### New Independence facility will expand fulfillment, warehousing and supply chain capacity for the family-owned manufacturer

INDEPENDENCE, Ky. (September 2, 2026) — RSA Properties LLC and Camco Chemical have announced plans to construct a new 130,000-square-foot warehouse and distribution center on Camco Chemical’s existing Holton Drive campus in Independence, Kentucky.

The new facility will expand Camco’s fulfillment and distribution capacity while strengthening its broader supply chain capabilities and supporting continued growth across its contract manufacturing operations in Northern Kentucky.

RSA Properties, the family-owned real estate entity developing the project, will work with Furlong Building as contractor. Once complete, Camco Chemical will integrate the facility into its existing operations.

Nashville, TN – Five Star Breaktime Solutions recently celebrated the opening of a consolidated regional office and distribution facility in Antioch, a neighborhood of Nashville, TN. This opening marks the second building relocation for Five Star this year, following a recent move in Dothan, AL.

 Over the last decade, the company outgrew its previous building several times, splitting departments into multiple locations due to service expansion, economic development, and surging customer base growth across Middle Tennessee. # Cubbo Invests US$1 Million in a New Distribution Center.

17.08.2026 Sofía Ortiz

 

Cubbo, the Latin American fulfillment technology and logistics company, has launched a new distribution center in Tultepec, State of Mexico, with an investment of US$1 million, as part of its plan to expand its logistics capacity for e-commerce and retail operations in Mexico.

The facility covers an area of 8,850 m², has the capacity to manage 53,000 inventory SKUs, and can process up to 450,000 orders per month. It also offers fulfillment, B2B, DTC, and cross-docking services, designed to facilitate connections between brands and the region’s leading retailers.

The investment is a response to the growth in sales volumes and the diversification of sales channels, factors that have increased the need for logistics operations that are faster, more flexible, and scalable.

Josu Gurtubay, co-founder and COO of Cubbo, has emphasized that logistics has become one of the strategic factors in brand competition, as responsiveness and order tracking have had a direct impact on the consumer experience.

results.author: FLEX. Logistik Deutschland
results.text:
# Mit OSN3 wächst unser deutsches Netzwerk auf drei Standorte. · 2026-09-02T00:00:00+00:00

Mit OSN3 wächst unser deutsches Netzwerk auf drei Standorte.

Am 1. September eröffnet unser neuer Standort in Lotte. Damit liegt jetzt die Hälfte unseres gesamten FLEX. Lagernetzwerks in Deutschland.

OSN3 ergänzt WIL1 in Wilhelmshaven und MAG2 in Hermsdorf. Drei Standorte, die unterschiedliche Teile derselben Aufgabe abdecken: Ware näher an den richtigen Markt bringen, Übergaben sauber halten und Verkäufern mehr Spielraum geben, wenn sich Volumen oder Vertriebskanäle verändern.

Und Deutschland ist nur ein Teil des Bildes. FLEX. betreibt inzwischen sechs Lagerstandorte in Deutschland, Frankreich, Polen und Großbritannien.

Für uns ist OSN3 deshalb mehr als eine neue Adresse in Lotte. Es ist ein weiterer Baustein in einem Netzwerk, das europäische Fulfilment weniger fragmentiert machen soll.

Willkommen im Netzwerk, OSN3. ❤️

#FLEXlogistik #EcommerceLogistik #Lagerlogistik #CrossBorderLogistics
